"Hey FSC Community,

As the FIFA World Cup 2026 approaches, I wanted to share some insights on how social media platforms are adapting to bring fans closer to the action. On Discord, we're seeing a focus on community building, with features like live events and Q&A sessions that let fans interact with creators and tournament officials.

Here are some key takeaways:

• **Community is key**: Discord's focus on community building shows us that fans want to be part of something bigger than just watching the game.
• **Authenticity matters**: Partnering with genuine soccer fans and creators who share their passion and perspectives is crucial for building a loyal community.
• **Real-time engagement is crucial**: Providing real-time updates and coverage of the tournament through live streaming and hashtag campaigns keeps fans engaged and invested in the action.
